title: Save API configuration with valid key and model only (default slider values)
description: Verifies saving works when only required fields are set and sliders remain at their defaults, showing success feedback.

steps.description: Click on "API Config" in the main navigation
Type "sk-valid-test-key-abcdef" into the OpenAI API key masked input
Click on an AI model card option (e.g., "gpt-4.1-mini")

title: Show error feedback when API key validation fails
description: Verifies the page displays a visible error message when an invalid API key is provided and saving is attempted.

steps.description: Click on "API Config" in the main navigation
Type "not-a-real-key" into the OpenAI API key masked input
Click on an AI model card option (e.g., "gpt-4o-mini")

title: Prevent saving when API key is empty
description: Verifies the user cannot save the configuration without an API key and sees visible validation feedback.

steps.description: Click on "API Config" in the main navigation
Click on an AI model card option (e.g., "gpt-4o-mini")

title: Prevent saving when no model is selected
description: Verifies the user cannot save without selecting a model and sees visible validation or error feedback.

steps.description: Click on "API Config" in the main navigation
Type "sk-valid-test-key-111111" into the OpenAI API key masked input

title: Change model selection and save the new selection
description: Verifies switching between model cards updates the selected model and the configuration can be saved successfully.

steps.description: Click on "API Config" in the main navigation
Type "sk-valid-test-key-222222" into the OpenAI API key masked input
Click on an AI model card option (first model)
Click on a different AI model card option (second model)

title: Show error feedback when saving fails due to server/network issue (observable via UI)
description: Verifies that when the save operation fails for any reason, the UI presents a visible error feedback message instead of success.

steps.description: Click on "API Config" in the main navigation
Type "sk-valid-test-key-trigger-error" into the OpenAI API key masked input
Click on an AI model card option (e.g., "gpt-4o-mini")
Verify text "No se pudo guardar" is visible

title: Save bot identity settings successfully (name, welcome messages, system prompt, quick replies)

steps.description: Click on "Bot Identity" in the main navigation
Type "Ori Asistente (QA)" into the bot name text input
Type "¡Hola! Soy Ori. ¿En qué puedo ayudarte hoy?" into the Spanish welcome message textarea
Type "Hi! I'm Ori. How can I help you today?" into the English welcome message textarea
Type "You are Ori, an AI assistant for Integro Suite. Be concise and helpful." into the system prompt textarea
Type "Ver planes" into the quick reply input field
Type "Hablar con soporte" into the quick reply input field
